content: The J1939 Diagno stic Communication Manager shall continue the sequence by subsequent calling the Dem_J1939DcmGetNextFreezeFrame, except the maximum sequence counter threshold per MainFunction is reached (see J1939DcmMaxFreezeFramesPerMainFunction ) or the return ed value is ‘ DEM_PENDING ’.

The J1939 Diagno stic Communication Manager shall continue the sequence by subsequent calling the Dem_J1939DcmGetNextFreezeFrame, except the maximum sequence counter threshold per MainFunction is reached (see J1939DcmMaxFreezeFramesPerMainFunction ) or the return ed value is ‘ DEM_PENDING ’.

The J1939 Diagno stic Communication Manager shall continue the sequence by subsequent calling the Dem_J1939DcmGetNextFreezeFrame, except the maximum sequence counter threshold per MainFunction is reached (see J1939DcmMaxFreezeFramesPerMainFunction ) or the return ed value is ‘ DEM_PENDING ’.
